rows.en: I have a question for you.
Whose car is this?
It is my friend's car.
He is at work every day.
But today he will not come.
What have you got in your hands?
This is your new book.
Why is it here?
I read it every day.
May I come back in an hour?
There is a new film today.
But I have a problem.
I have no money.
That is not a problem.
Everything will be fine.

rows.ru: Это дом, в котором живёт мой отец.
rows.en: This is the house where my father lives.
He never works here.
He needs to play with his child.
Time is what it takes.
But he has no time.
We have been standing here for an hour.
Father said we had to go.
There are cars parked by the school.
Let us walk to work.
I do not want to stand around.
I am looking for a bank.
It is in the centre, behind the market.
And where is the hotel?
The hotel is in the centre too.
The airport is outside the city.
What is the hotel's address?
It is on the square, by the museum.
And our office is in the park.
Everybody comes to us.
We are there every day.
How do I get to the station?
You have to go along this road.

rows.ru: Там почта, а за ней библиотека.
rows.en: The post office is there, and the library is behind it.
There is a big building site by the church.
And the station is in the town centre.
Beyond the bridge there is a village.
In the village there is a new club building.
The club has a postal address.
And the doctor's surgery?
It is in the same building.
We live in a new district.
There is a station and a pharmacy here.
The pharmacy has a big window.
And the cinema is in the middle of the little town.
Behind the station there is a builders' market.
There is a monument in our quarter.
Behind it is the market square.
And in the side street there is a swimming school.
My father used to work there.
He loves swimming very much.
We are going to Moscow.
Father will go by car.
And will you arrive today?
We set off in an hour.
I do not like flying.
Our train has already left.

rows.ru: У меня есть билет на автобус.
rows.en: I have a bus ticket.
The bus driver is here already.
The tourists are travelling by ship.
And we will go by bus.
Our trip is today.
Where are my passport and visa?
They are in your hands.

rows.ru: Мы поедем на такси или на метро?
rows.en: Shall we go by taxi or by metro?
There are always a lot of passengers on the metro.
We are leaving today.
The luggage is already in the carriage.
Have you got a map?
The train departs in an hour.
We always travel by train.
My friend is leaving today.
He has a new motorcycle.

rows.ru: Мы катались на нём каждый день.
rows.en: We used to ride it every day.
But the engine does not work any more.
We do not want to part.
My father is away on business.

rows.ru: Он выехал из города в час.
rows.en: He left the city at one o'clock.
Right now he is flying to Moscow.
And I have got a bicycle.

rows.ru: Я поеду на нём в школу.
rows.en: I will ride it to school.
